Dix mots

  • iPhone / iPad: Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › French (France). Download an Enhanced or Premium voice (Audrey or Thomas), then reload.
  • Mac: System Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › System voice › Manage Voices › French. Download a Premium voice.
  • Windows: open this in Microsoft Edge and pick an Online (Natural) voice, such as Denise or Henri.
  • Android or Chrome: pick Google français.
